description: Current status of one service: verdict (up/degraded/down/unknown), plain-English summary, official status page level, our own HTTP probe, and user reports in the last hour. For AI API providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and others on /ai), also returns recommended_fallbacks — currently healthy alternatives you can switch to.

slug.description: Service slug or common name, e.g. chatgpt (or 'openai'), claude (or 'anthropic'), aws, stripe. Use list_services to discover slugs.

name: get_status
title: Get service status
